description: 國光牌海運機油 ( Marilube Oil )產品說明書 [oil fuels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣中油股份有限公司. 國光牌海運機油 ( Marilube Oil )產品說明書提供海運輪船柴油機、透平電動機、蒸汽透平機、蒸汽機、雜項船舶、漁船潤滑用油之選擇和特性描述。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣中油股份有限公司. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-12 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
